llm.summary: This is a coherent Chinese real-estate skill kit with disclosed local calculators, templates, mock demo data, and a user-run installer.

dimensions.detail: Executable behavior is proportionate: local Python calculators, local template rendering, local mock data, and optional local installation. I found no hidden network calls, credential harvesting, destructive commands, or background workers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: install.sh copies a user-specified rendered skill into detected or specified agent skill directories and records a SHA-256 file; this modifies agent skill state but is explicit, user-directed, and limited to the chosen skill directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation language is broad and mostly Chinese, so it may trigger on ordinary Chinese real-estate requests, but the scope is disclosed and consistent with a China-focused real-estate toolkit.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to generated output directories, optional calculator templates under my_templates, installed skill files, and a .sha256 record. No unbounded persistence or privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The top-level skill describes a real-estate AI skill repository, and the inspected artifacts match that purpose: calculator tools, sales SOP skills, brand-skill templates, and a mock adapter for demonstration data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want a Chinese/China-market real-estate skill kit. Review generated brand skills before installing them because install.sh persists them into your agent's skills directory, and verify all financial, tax, mortgage, and policy figures against official local sources before using them for real transactions.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The mock housing CLI and installer are supporting components documented in the README, adapter docs, SKILL overview, and install script, not hidden capabilities or evidence of tool poisoning.
[P6] expected: The flagged 'return rules' code returns real-estate calculation rules from the local rule engine; it does not access or disclose system prompts or hidden agent instructions.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only language is consistent with the stated China/Chinese real-estate market focus, though users should expect a primarily Chinese experience.
[LP3] expected: The top-level SKILL.md does not declare an allowed-tools field, but inspected behavior is local and purpose-aligned; this is a transparency note rather than a security concern.
[SQP-1] expected: Some trigger phrases are broad real-estate terms, which could cause over-activation, but they remain within the advertised real-estate assistance purpose.
